# ShunyaScape

> ShunyaScape is a free multiplayer 3D city-building and life-simulation game that runs in the web browser. Players share one persistent 200×200 city, earn ShunyaCoins by working jobs, collecting resources and completing quests, buy permits to build roads, homes, shops and skyscrapers, and live alongside a population of computer-controlled citizens who follow daily routines.

## Key facts

- Genre: multiplayer city builder and life simulation (sandbox)
- Platform: any modern web browser with WebGL; no download or install
- Price: free to play; a free account saves progress
- World: one shared, persistent 200×200 city simulated in real time for all players
- Citizens: 220+ computer-controlled citizens with homes, jobs and daily schedules (sleep, commute, work, lunch, errands, park walks); builder citizens walk to new construction sites and build them
- Day length: one in-game day lasts eight real hours
- Multiplayer: everyone plays in the same city; parties hold up to 8 players
- Currency: ShunyaCoins (SC); new players start with 100 SC

## How to earn

- Work jobs: tech office in skyscrapers (+50 SC), house repairs (+30 SC), helping construction sites (+20 SC)
- Collect coins (+10 SC), energy crystals (+25 SC) and crates (+15 SC, +5 wood) around the map
- Harvest wood by punching or kicking trees
- Complete quests (find the lost dog Fido, plant three trees, climb a skyscraper) and achievements

## Building permits (one-time purchase)

- Road Builder 50 SC, Arborist 100 SC, Barber Shop 100 SC, Cloth Shop 150 SC, Restaurant 200 SC, Residential 250 SC, Police Station 300 SC, Commercial (skyscrapers) 500 SC

## Survival

- Hunger drops every in-game day; eat at restaurants to restore it. Three in-game days without food resets progress.

## Controls

- Arrow keys walk, Shift sprints, Space jumps, W/A/S/D orbit the camera, Q/E zoom, R talks/shops/works, U/I punch or kick

## Links

- Play: the home page of this site
